approval_review.reason: Automatic review rejected broad untested replacement of shared global dispatch and cross-realm exception handling. Work continued as an isolated prototype with separate build artifacts.

not_integrated: Production bootstrap global listeners and global DOM phases
regressions_found_and_corrected_in_proto: Handler initially ran after later listeners
Removed/re-registered callback initially matched an old snapshot entry
remaining_validation_and_design: Complete handler bookkeeping, including add/removeEventListener with the same callback as onerror and noncallable handler objects
Cross-realm dispatch of Event objects needs explicit event-record owner and global target identity checks
Native accessors currently cover onerror; other global event handler attributes still need registration-order semantics
Callback-interface handleEvent conversion and getter exceptions need complete coverage
Validate host parser/module reporting and primary testharness failure behavior in the isolated checkout before production integration
scope: Isolated prototype only. Not integrated into the production runtime and not a new conformance score.
verified_contracts: Capture, once, removal during dispatch, abort signals and passive cancellation
Global ErrorEvent handler five-argument convention and true-return cancellation
Listener exception reporting preserves thrown identity and continues dispatch
Native reported errors are trusted ErrorEvents
Removed/re-registered listeners do not revive old snapshot entries
MutationObserver exceptions report to the callback realm, not the observer or Error-object realm
